sentences.en: She managed to back up through the narrow driveway.
sentences.zh: 她设法倒车通过了狭窄的车道。

sentences.en: There's a big black truck parked in your driveway.
sentences.zh: 有一辆大黑卡车停在你的车道上。

sentences.en: Please move your car. You're blocking my driveway.
sentences.zh: 请把你的车移开，你挡住了我的车道。

senses.zh: （从建筑物，住房，车库等通往大路的）私人车道
